name: Vision
source:
When the hero goes to the shopping district it starts to rain. His classmate hides from the rain next to his house so he invites her to dry wet clothes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-september-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角前往商店街時開始下雨。同班同學在他家旁避雨，於是他邀請她進屋晾乾溼衣服。

［譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-september-1991.html]VNDB Review[/url]］
